Two more schools join for the autumn term

{{DATE}} — Reading clubs open at two more primary schools in September, bringing the total to fourteen. Twenty new volunteers finished training last month.

Summer reading challenge: 380 children finished six books

{{DATE_MINUS_10}} — The September party handed out 380 certificates, the most in the challenge's history. Thank you to every volunteer and every family who kept the diaries going.
